proposals.title: Reconcile intended, committed and observed media inventory
proposals.next_action: Extend the maintained append owner with bounded intended/committed/failed/observed states only if used for recovery or exact residency reporting. Test synchronous and asynchronous failure, browser eviction, overlapping appends and source replacement in real MSE before measuring avoided work.

proposals.title: Evict and refill complete decoding dependency closures
proposals.next_action: Keep the strict-before-RAP regression. Reopen only for a reproduced long-GOP/configuration/preroll refill failure in a maintained browser route.

proposals.title: Advertise cache capabilities, not one ambiguous buffered value
proposals.next_action: Retain existing distinct diagnostics. Reopen when a consumer needs a decoder-ready or cross-track readiness contract that these fields cannot express; include sparse-track and missing-audio output witnesses.

proposals.title: Budget unique backing allocations separately from logical payload
proposals.next_action: Keep the compaction stop. Reopen only with a real owner retaining small live slices after its siblings finish, then measure unique backing retention and copy cost; cache counters are not process memory.

proposals.title: Negotiate resource representation and bounded outstanding ownership
proposals.next_action: For one concrete new adapter, declare accepted chunk/frame family, format, memory domain, maximum outstanding objects and terminal release. Reject incompatible families and run exhaustion/cancel/source-replacement plus output comparisons before any conversion-cost claim.

proposals.title: Map/import only frames needed for presentation
proposals.next_action: Reopen only when a measured presenter/preview trace shows avoidable mapping of superseded frames; compare total owner cost and required visible output while retaining dependency decoding.

proposals.title: Use coherent native/polyfilled constructor families
proposals.next_action: Apply adapter-local family checks if a software WebCodecs adapter is introduced. Reject mixed families before publication and repeat output/fallback qualification; do not install a global shim.

proposals.title: Delay mux initialization until actual output configuration is known
proposals.next_action: When introducing a browser encoder, gate init on bounded first outputs of every selected track; test mismatched requested/actual config, a delayed track, cancellation and a later epoch before admission.

proposals.title: Preserve trim, codec delay and decoder preroll exactly once
proposals.next_action: Use independently decoded impulse/channel-marked AAC, MP3 and Opus fixtures at head/tail and seek boundaries; declare each trim owner and sample units. Require exact counts/positions before admitting any new wrapper or split route.

proposals.title: Drive split playback from consumed media samples, not elapsed context alone
proposals.next_action: Retain consumed-sample feedback. Reopen for a real independent audio owner with a starvation/rate trace demonstrating drift; then qualify digital markers and acoustic latency separately.

proposals.title: Make audio preload, batching and render deadlines separate budgets
proposals.next_action: Keep the existing stop. Reopen with a pre-gesture producer/occupancy trace or measured callback deadline miss; do not infer callback timing from Node execution.

proposals.title: Prefer qualified audio wrapping over unnecessary audio decoding
proposals.next_action: Select a real source whose cheapest unchanged route fails, then compare exact compressed frames and decoded timing/channels across the specific wrapper; charge parse/mux/setup. Preserve working direct playback.

proposals.title: Choose seek-versus-skip using validated container boundaries
proposals.next_action: Keep bounded local metadata skipping. Reopen remote policy only with a measured Range-capable transport workload and stale-hint, malformed-size and ignored-Range controls; include index acquisition cost.

proposals.title: Construct checked metadata projections with bounded offset fixpoints
proposals.next_action: Reopen for a specific recording that cannot use the fixed-size/reserved-space baseline. Prove checked convergence across EBML integer-width boundaries, all offset targets, opaque-metadata handling, source identity and bounded failure before timing.

proposals.title: Use consumer-owned source-priority and cancellation leases
proposals.next_action: Retain isolated preview ownership. Introduce shared leases only for a requested shared scheduler and demonstrate overlapping consumers, stale verified blocks and independent cancellation; never seek/flush the main decoder for previews.

proposals.title: Recover reconnect overlap with explicit identity and confidence levels
proposals.next_action: Reopen only for an explicit reconnecting audio source contract. Byte-verify hash candidates, retain unique samples, bound overlap, reject silence/periodic ambiguity and label estimated alternate-source alignment separately.

proposals.title: Keep clock epochs and transition metadata tied to their source
proposals.next_action: Keep existing epoch authorities. Reopen only on a trace showing double offset, stale configuration/GOP metadata or premature final drain at a specific owner boundary; include delayed old-epoch events.

proposals.title: Reuse subtitle content independently of placement updates
proposals.next_action: Compare position-only versus content changes on a persistent moving-ASS workload, font replacement and resize; independently verify glyph/color/placement and measure full rendering/upload cost before adding a tile cache.

proposals.title: Expose repairs and resynchronization instead of silently discarding data
proposals.next_action: Start with existing AAC timestamp and AVC/HEVC DTS repairs: emit bounded reason/source-epoch/input-output identities with unchanged-media controls. Then inject junk, truncated init and inconsistent metadata; distinguish strict rejection, requested salvage and live concealment before broadening.

proposals.title: Build an oracle matrix with independent structural and behavioral references
proposals.next_action: For EB01/EB09/EB14/EB19 experiments, fill the matrix with a second structural implementation or independently authored parser and a failing negative control. Record lineage, tolerance and exact scope; do not label Node contracts browser conformance.

proposals.title: Limit live work by dependency-group deadlines, not VOD policy
proposals.next_action: Reopen for an explicit live transport/latency policy outside the current packaged-stream owner. Test late groups, dependency closure, pause/resume, A/V/subtitle resync and a strict VOD no-drop control; report skipped intervals and latency, not equal-output savings.

proposals.title: Publish narrow contracts for prepared-media reuse and virtual presentations
proposals.next_action: When a repeated-preparation workload warrants integration, key reuse by immutable source, selected tracks, recipe, metadata epoch, destination and runtime; test individual invalidations and consumer cancellation, then charge retained memory and cold preparation.

evidence_level: Current source review, 76 Node contract checks and 3 synthetic boundary probes; no new browser or performance qualification.
canonical_mapping: Complete: 22 evaluated proposals, 19 existing owners and 3 new bounded homes.
decision_scope: Existing parent decisions preserved; new homes have explicit scoped decisions.
